::: {#def-representation-learning}

#### Representation learning (feature learning)

**Representation learning**, or **feature learning**,
is [machine learning](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-machine-learning)
in which the algorithm learns from data
the [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) a model computes from its raw input,
as well as how the model maps those features to its output
[@goodfellow2016deep, Ch. 1].

:::
